name: Commodities
description: Energy, metals, and agricultural futures: curves, roll, and inventories.

dimensions.name: commodity
dimensions.description: Commodity (WTI, Brent, natural gas, gold, corn)

metrics.name: curve_slope
metrics.description: Deferred minus front-month price, as a percent of front

metrics.name: roll_yield
metrics.description: Annualized return from rolling futures along the curve

metrics.name: open_interest
metrics.description: Open futures contracts at a point in time

metrics.name: inventory
metrics.description: Reported physical inventory at a point in time

conventions.rule: State the price unit (USD/bbl, USD/MMBtu, USD/oz, cents/bu); do not compare across units.
Continuous futures series must state the roll rule; unadjusted splices create false jumps.
Contango means deferred above front (positive slope); backwardation the reverse.

insight_rules.reason: Prices are not additive across commodities.

caveats.text: Front-month series jump at contract rolls; the change may reflect the roll, not the market.

chart_conventions.rule: Plot forward curves with contract month on the x-axis, one line per observation date.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
